deviceNote: Fixed to an Xbox Series X plus one reference 54.7-inch ENERGY STAR-certified television. Series S and alternate display choices are not yet modeled.
directWaterBoundary: Modeled direct cooling and humidification water for the game-server data center only; telecom-facility water is unquantified.
label: Gaming Console (Xbox Series X + TV)
note: Locally rendered online multiplayer, not cloud gaming. The central estimate includes the console, reference TV, allocated home networking, fixed access and core transport, modeled game-server IT, and data-center overhead. Downloads, patches, manufacturing, standby, and optional texture streaming are excluded.
serverEnergyBoundary: Off-prem fixed access and core transport plus modeled game-server facility electricity; excludes the allocated home gateway.
totalEnergyBoundary: Console, reference TV, allocated home gateway, fixed access and core transport, modeled game-server IT, and PUE overhead for one player-hour.
totalWaterBoundary: U.S.-average operational water consumption: electricity-generation water for quantified components plus modeled direct game-server data-center water.
unitHint: One active player-hour; local rendering over fixed broadband
